titre: GraphCert: Bootstrap Agentic Graph Reasoning with Certified Evidence Rubrics
resume: arXiv:2609.38798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph agents extend large language models (LLMs) with the ability to actively explore and reason over knowledge graphs through multi-step interactions with graph tools. However, training capable graph agents typically requires large collections of question-answer pairs and reasoning trajectories, whose manual construction is costly and difficult to scale.
